description: Franjas de protección contra incendios de Canet d'Adri is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by canet-adri.cat. Canet d'Adri's fire protection strips is a set of geographical data with information on the regulations of the campaign to light a fire for the burning of plant remains, as well as the requirements that must be met. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Fire protection strips of Canet d'Adri" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Canet d'Adri, Fire prevention, Prevención de incendios, Protección forestal, Prevenció d'incendis, Forest protection. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
